summary: Phase 4 (FR-4) implementation satisfies AC-4 after a focused test fix. The route now calls getRoleplayEvaluationContext before storage upload, passes real canonical source excerpts to the evaluator, persists audioStorageKey only on successful upload, and contains no `as never`/`as unknown as` casts. The initial route test for excerpts was shallow (it only verified the route built an evaluator function and did not prove the excerpts reached the raw evaluator); this was fixed in commit 91da6adc to assert the wrapped evaluator is called with the non-empty excerpt array. All gate commands pass.

nonblocking_findings.title: Migration rollback caveat
nonblocking_findings.description: 0023_cultured_sunspot.sql is a one-line `ALTER TABLE ... DROP NOT NULL`. Rolling it back (re-adding NOT NULL) would fail if any rows with audio_storage_key IS NULL were inserted during the forward phase. This is acceptable for a Drizzle-generated forward migration, but production rollback would require a data-migration step first.

evidence.description: getRoleplayEvaluationContext is awaited before any storage.put call, satisfying the ordering requirement.
audioUploadSucceeded flag is set only when storage.put resolves; audioStorageKey is passed as null on rejection.
wrappedEvaluate passes evaluationContext.scenario, evaluationContext.rubric, and evaluationContext.canonicalSourceExcerpts to the raw evaluator with no `as never`/`as unknown as` casts.
Excerpts test now asserts mockEvaluateRaw was called with the non-empty excerpt array, fixing the shallow assertion.
Single-line migration relaxes audio_storage_key from NOT NULL to nullable, matching the new code path that omits the key on upload failure.
